    WHAT DO I NEED TO APPLY

    Get your new UAE visa applied and approved quickly. Visa Change and Exit packages customized for your convenience.

    • Valid passport (must have at least six months of validity remaining)
    • Passport-size photo
    • Completed visa application form
    • Proof of travel itinerary (such as flight reservations)
    • Proof of accommodation in the UAE (such as hotel reservations)
    • Financial documents showing that you have sufficient funds to cover your stay in the UAE

    What is Golden Visa UAE?

    The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residence visa (5–10 years) for investors, entrepreneurs, professionals, and talented individuals, offering permanent residency and exclusive benefits in Abu Dhabi and other emirates.

    How to check visa validity in UAE?

    You can check UAE visa validity online through the official GDRFA Abu Dhabi portal or the ICP UAE website by entering your passport number and visa details.

    How to check UAE visa status?

    Visit the ICP UAE portal or GDRFA Abu Dhabi website to check your UAE visa status online using your passport number, visa application number, or file number.

    What is Partner Visa in UAE?

     A UAE Partner Visa allows business partners or investors to live and work in Abu Dhabi or other emirates by sponsoring themselves through company ownership.

    How to check UAE e-Visa online?

    To verify a UAE e-Visa, go to the official UAE visa status check page on the ICP portal, enter your e-Visa number and passport details, and confirm your visa validity.

    How to apply UAE tourist visa from Philippines?

    Filipinos can apply for a UAE tourist visa through airlines (Emirates, Etihad), trusted travel agencies like Waytransit Travels & Tourism, or UAE-based sponsors by submitting passport, photo, and required documents.

    How much is UAE visa?

    The UAE visa cost depends on type: a 30-day tourist visa starts around Price on Request–400, while 90-day visit visas range from Price on Request–1,200. Prices vary by provider.

    How to get UAE work visa?

    To get a UAE work visa, you need a job offer from a UAE employer. The company applies for your work permit through MOHRE, after which you receive an entry permit and residence visa.

    When UAE visa open for Pakistan?

    Currently, UAE visit and tourist visas for Pakistan are open. Pakistani citizens can apply online through travel agencies, airlines, or UAE immigration portals.
